description.zh:
Audience 用于指定 Token 的预期持有者（即使用方）。
当您通过自建 Web 应用接入 DSW页面 时，请将 audience 设置为 ThirdParty。
description.en: Specifies the intended recipient (audience) of the token. If you access the DSW page from a self-built web application, set this parameter to ThirdParty.
The instance ID. For information about how to obtain an instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~470439~~).

description.zh:
签发的token类型
* Access : 用于进入DSW实例内部执行操作。具备操作权限。
* View：用于只读分享 DSW 实例信息（如状态、配置、日志等），不具备修改或控制权限，适用于协作者或外部查看者。
description.en:
The type of token to issue.

- Access: Grants permissions to enter a DSW instance and perform operations.

- View: Grants read-only permissions to share DSW instance information, such as status, configuration, and logs. This type does not grant permissions to modify or control the instance. It is suitable for collaborators or external viewers.

title.zh: 获取实例临时鉴权信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dsw get-token --instance-id dsw-730xxxxxxxxxx --expire-time 60 --type Access --audience Aliyun --api-version 2022-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pai-dsw GET /api/v2/tokens --region cn-hangzhou --Type Access --InstanceId 'dsw-730xxxxxxxxxx' --Audience Aliyun --ExpireTime 60 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
